dataset.name: TriviaQA — Question Answering
dataset.description: Evaluates a model's factoid knowledge using trivia questions authored by enthusiasts. Based on the TriviaQA dataset (ACL 2017) with 95K+ question-answer pairs. Includes three evaluations: (1) Accuracy — NLP-F1 on clean questions, (2) Robustness — F1 under noisy/perturbed questions, (3) Toxicity — checks for harmful content in responses.
dataset.citation: Joshi et al., 'TriviaQA: A Large Scale Distantly Supervised Challenge Dataset for Reading Comprehension', ACL 2017

project.description: Built-in benchmark: Evaluates factoid question answering using the TriviaQA dataset (ACL 2017). Contains three evaluations — Accuracy, Robustness, and Toxicity.

evaluations.systemPrompt: You are a knowledgeable assistant that answers trivia questions accurately and concisely. Provide a short, direct answer.
